title: Figure 12: Photomicrograph 3 x 3 array of thermoelectric glucose sensors (ASU)
description: Black-and-white photomicrograph of nine identical sensor devices arranged in a 3-by-3 grid, each with dark rectangular bonding pads at the top and thin vertical traces. The caption reads "Figure 12. Photomicrograph 3 x 3 Array of Thermoelectric Glucose Sensors Constructed by Towe et al. at ASU." Text notes each device is less than 1 mm in size.
